text.tspan: Communication · A² A1 · broadcast role collaboration
A subject changes state or emits lifecycle
The subject publishes a change notification.
Subscription registry, event payload, and observer
Currently registered observers are notified under
Observer failure does not corrupt subject
Callback errors and cascades are isolated
1 register(callback) → 2 create(change) → 3 publish(event) → 4 notify(event) → 5 deliver(event) → 6 acknowledge(result)
Evidence: 32/41 repositories, 29/36 families; 32 trajectories (16 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Event emitter, listener, hooks, and stream observers.
Negative control: Polling the subject rather than notification is not the observer pointcut.
